description: Application for prior notification of development for the conversion of commercial/business/service building to 48 flats
decision_conditions: Works for this development are to be commenced not later than 3 years from the date of this decision notice.  Failure to commence within this time period would require a fresh application.
Prior Approval is required (given) in accordance with the details as provided within the application.

The occupation of the residential flats authorised by this prior approval shall not commence until all the works shown on the drawings approved pursuant to the planning application Ref: P0800.26 including those matters to be secured by way of condition have been completed on site.

Prior to first occupation, cycle storage shall be provided on site in accordance with details which shall have been previously submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority indicating accessible and adequate cycle storage provision for the proposed use, and shall then be maintained permanently thereafter in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision for cycle parking.

Prior to first occupation, waste and recycling facilities shall be provided on site in accordance with details which shall have been previously submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, indicating facilities for the proposed residential use hereby permitted, and shall then be maintained permanently thereafter in accordance with the approved details.
Reason; To ensure adequate capacity is provided on site, and to protect the amenity of occupiers of the development and also the locality generally.
P200 Rev A, P201 Rev A, P202 Rev A
